C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-SEGMENT-245-V2.Summary: Expose current and archived plans as a persistent one-action segmented control.
C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-SEGMENT-245-V2.Problem: The primary lifecycle view is mixed into the general plan filters, so moving between current and archived plans requires opening a dropdown and obscures a frequent high-level navigation state.

Goals.Goal: Show `Текущие | Архив` permanently in the plans toolbar.
Switch lifecycle views with one click, tap or keyboard action without changing plan data or lifecycle semantics.
Preserve search and selection when valid, and fall back to the first available plan or an accurate empty state.
Provide stable desktop/mobile geometry, visible focus, text-first selection and reduced-motion behavior.

Constraints.Constraint: No API, SQLite schema, migration, plan lifecycle, source row, evidence or document intake change.
The lifecycle view is never-learn; usage statistics cannot change the default, value, order or position.
The iteration does not redesign the remaining filters, plan detail or source-row editor.
The temporary branch worker is removed before final assertions and exists only to apply the reviewed append-only integration to the existing entry script.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Move every plan filter into a popover.
Redesign plan cards or the inspector.
Change archive/restore commands or impact calculation.
Add adaptive ranking to lifecycle state.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: One click or tap on `Архив` shows archived plans and one action on `Текущие` returns to active plans.
Lifecycle selection is no longer required inside the general filter dropdown.
Each segment exposes selected semantics, visible focus and a reliable 44 px target on desktop and mobile.
Search and a still-valid selected plan survive switching; an invalid selection is replaced deterministically without a stale detail.
Empty current and archive views explain the state and preserve the available primary action.
Focused unit/browser tests, full CI and GRACE final pass on one exact head before squash merge and terminal archive.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact branch head proves one-action lifecycle navigation on desktop, mobile, keyboard and reduced motion without changing persisted data.
